meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 它把 Discord 适配器复制到 src/channels/、注册并安装依赖，然后跑构建和注册测试；再引导你创建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，自动取回 Application ID、公钥和你的用户 ID 写入 .env，并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人频道时接管，通常在 /setup 流程中或之后单独运行；Discord 开发者门户里的应用创建需要你手动完成。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑测试

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token：<token>
say.note: 会校验并取回 App ID 与公钥

say.text: 机器人已邀请，帮我打开和它的 DM 频道
say.note: 取回 DM 频道 ID 作为会话地址

howto.what_en: It copies the Discord adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the adapter package, and runs the build and registration test. Then it guides you through creating a bot, pasting the Bot Token, storing the credentials in .env, and restarting the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw, typically inside the /setup flow or as a standalone run. App creation in the Discord Developer Portal stays manual.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs the tests

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token: <token>
say_en.note: Validates it and derives the App ID and public key

say_en.text: The bot is invited, open my DM channel with it
say_en.note: Returns the DM channel id used as the address
